pre_run_estimand_amendment.reason: The K-induced difference g_block can have the correct derivative even when the support reconstruction derivative is not identity, so dg_block/dx alone does not establish that the actual restricted predictor has the correct local law.
pre_run_estimand_amendment.repair: Make the actual restricted predictor change h_block the primary decoded-predictor law estimand, retain g_block as a required K-induced mechanism co-estimand, and require both for any one-K local-law claim. Use h_global for the predictive global positive control.

pre_run_direct_closure_amendment.timing: after H/G estimand approval and partial code implementation, with no task/source freeze, utilization smoke, new-seed training, checkpoint evaluation, or scientific outcome preceding the amendment
pre_run_direct_closure_amendment.reason: Decoded G_block-versus-G_source Jacobian agreement does not directly test whether active latent codes remain in the selected coordinates under the unchanged global K; dense family representatives did not guarantee exact per-basin projector-cardinality equality; and the inherited checkpoint selector was insufficiently disclosed as an every-physical-step reencoding rollout.
pre_run_direct_closure_amendment.repair: Add direct change-normalized leakage of family-projected codes zP_b on every frozen sparse-family-assigned verification point and require it for joint H/G and G-only one-K mechanism tiers, while explicitly withholding source-containment and whole-subspace invariance claims. Steelman the dense control with a fixed top-|P_sparse,b| projector from its center encoding and reuse the identical sparse-family-assigned physical points. State and source-lock the exact every-step physical reencoding validation selector and treat it as a recipe limitation rather than autonomous-K selection.

blocking_uncertainty: V1 gave perfect held-out family routing and identity-optimal finite-radius slope assignments in nine rows, with no law conclusion because two of three seeds failed predeclared intercept or local-linearity validity gates. New checkpoints are required to test the Jacobian claim without post-hoc threshold repair.
hypothesis: For a newly trained sparse KAE, label-free support families select restrictions of one unchanged learned global K such that both the actual restricted decoded predictor and its K-induced component recover the three genuinely different GatedLocalLinear one-step laws.
competing_explanations: The old result was a three-seed fluctuation.
The full nonlinear encoder/decoder and K recover local laws, but sparse support blocks do not.
Any cardinality-matched coordinate masks, including dense tanh masks, identify the laws equally well.
Near-identity K, affine fixed-point offsets, or radius selection make a raw Jacobian match look artificially favorable.
The K-induced difference has the right Jacobian only because support reconstruction supplies a compensating non-identity derivative; the actual restricted predictor has the wrong law.

v1_provenance_and_boundary.not_a_threshold_relaxation: V1 remains invalid. V2 changes the primary measurement from a finite-disk fitted slope to a kink-guarded autograd Jacobian and uses entirely new training seeds; V1 gates and artifacts are never recomputed or reclassified.

benchmark.true_law: Delta_j = R4(dt A_j)-I, where R4 is the classical fourth-order RK polynomial and A_j is the known basin-local continuous matrix.
benchmark.locality_guard: Every calibration, verification, and robustness point must be verified to remain in its intended basin-local region; the analytic RK4 map must agree with env.step to max absolute error <=1e-6.

geometry_authentication.analytic_map: For every point x assigned to evaluation basin b, compare env.step(x) with c_b + R4(dt A_b)(x-c_b).
geometry_authentication.kink_count_derivation: 3 basins x 2 epsilons x 2 physical coordinates x 2 signs = 24.
geometry_authentication.finite_radius_count_derivation: 3 basins x 5 radii x 64 fixed antithetic directions = 960.
geometry_authentication.required_checks: Every point must have region_label(x)=b, every observed and analytic value must be finite, every category count must equal its frozen count, and the maximum coordinatewise absolute env/RK4 error in every category must be <=1e-6.
geometry_authentication.failure_branch: Write an authenticated ineligible_geometry shard with category/basin counts, region matches, and maximum errors; do not compute or report H/G mechanism metrics from that row.

new_seed_contract.pairing_scope: The paired seed fixes the data-generation seed and the evaluation uses exactly the same physical states, but different architectures consume random numbers differently. It does not assert identical parameter-initialization or minibatch RNG draws.

representative_schema_compatibility_norm.behavior_equivalence: DECODER.NORMALIZE_ATOMS is inactive for LISTAKM, whose trainable dictionary is row-normalized inside its latent-linear decode; HYPERLISTA.STEP_SCALE is inactive because the encoder is LISTA; SPARSITY_TARGET=rollout equals the historical runner getattr fallback; obsolete STRUCTURED was disabled. These are schema normalization, not scientific-recipe changes.

sparse.decoder: trainable 256x2 dictionary, row-normalized inside LISTAKM decode and linear in latent z, with no trainable or affine bias; this is not an nn.Linear module

training_arms.checkpoint_selection: For each arm/seed, the inherited skae.training.runner.evaluate helper selects the checkpoint with minimum fixed-validation final physical-state error over 200 steps from skae.evaluation.rollout_every_step_reencode: after every one-step encode-K-decode prediction, the predicted physical state is re-encoded before the next step. The strict-less-than update makes the earliest evaluated checkpoint win an exact error tie. Checkpoints are considered every 500 training steps and at the final step; final weights are only the existing non-finite fallback. H/G Jacobians, family-projected-code closure, support routing, and every other V2 mechanism metric cannot select a checkpoint.
training_arms.checkpoint_selection_scope_and_limitatio: This outcome-independent selector is defensible for the frozen one-step/Jacobian mechanism analysis because it never sees any mechanism outcome, but it is not an autonomous repeated-K selector and cannot support an autonomous-latent-rollout claim. Every positive result must disclose this inherited recipe limitation.

task_table_contract.full_order: sparse seeds 100-109 followed by paired dense seeds 100-109
task_table_contract.smoke_order: sparse seeds 9100-9109 followed by dense seeds 9200-9209
task_table_contract.sparse_audit: exact match to representative frozen config on all scientific fields except seed/labels/output
task_table_contract.dense_audit: tanh hidden activation; linear latent output; zero sparsity, shrinkage, dropout, weight decay, block, soft-block, decoder-coherence, and group/top-k mechanisms

label_free_family_discovery.family_algorithm: For the sparse arm only, use a fixed greedy exact-support Jaccard codebook followed by nearest fixed representative assignment.

evaluation_only_family_matching.mapping: one-to-one Hungarian assignment maximizing calibration family counts
evaluation_only_family_matching.matched_support_diagnostics: Report each matched representative's cardinality and latent fraction plus all three pairwise Jaccards. Every mask must be nonempty and proper (cardinality 1..255), and every matched pair must have Jaccard<0.50 as implied by the frozen greedy codebook; a violation invalidates routing.

dense_evaluation_projector_steelman.definition: For each paired seed and known evaluation basin center c_b, let k_b=|P_sparse,b| for the sparse calibration-matched family. Set P_dense,b to the top-k_b coordinates of |E_dense(c_b)|, breaking ties by ascending coordinate index, and freeze it for every dense H/G, closure, kink, affine, finite-radius, and coordinate-null metric.
dense_evaluation_projector_steelman.exact_cardinality_requirement: For every paired seed/basin, |P_dense,b| must equal |P_sparse,b| exactly and both must be in 1..255; otherwise the dense row is not evaluable.
dense_evaluation_projector_steelman.physical_point_matching: For dense direct family-projected-code closure, use exactly the same fixed sparse-family-assigned verification-point indices and physical states as the paired sparse seed/basin.
dense_evaluation_projector_steelman.known_information_disclosure: Known basin centers and the paired sparse projector cardinalities are used only at benchmark evaluation time. This intentionally favors the dense control and cannot help sparse training or sparse family discovery.
dense_evaluation_projector_steelman.dense_family_discovery_role: Dense family discovery is not used to choose a projector or determine dense specificity validity; it is omitted from the decision estimand.

primary_autograd_estimand.primary_law_matrix: H_b = d h_f^block(x)/dx evaluated by autograd at known center c_b with P_f fixed
primary_autograd_estimand.required_mechanism_matrix: G_b = d g_f^block(x)/dx at the same center and fixed P_f
primary_autograd_estimand.reconstruction_derivative_guard: H_b=G_b+d[D(E(x)P_f)]/dx-I. Therefore H and G are separately scored; a G-only pass cannot establish an actual predictor law.
primary_autograd_estimand.near_identity_guard: H, G, and the global controls are physical-space predictor/update Jacobians compared with Delta_j=R4(dt A_j)-I. For g, K=I produces the zero update and an identity-baseline relative error of one; h additionally exposes reconstruction-derivative error.
primary_autograd_estimand.basis_scope: Costs are measured in physical state space and are invariant to consistent latent coordinate relabeling; sparse support itself is intentionally coordinate dependent.

three_law_identification.cost: For M in {H_block,G_block,H_global,G_global}, C_s^M[b,j]=||M_s,b-Delta_j||_F for model seed s, predicted basin/support b, and candidate true law j.
three_law_identification.assignment_per_seed: a_s=sum_b C_s[b,b]/min_{pi!=identity}sum_b C_s[b,pi(b)] over all five nonidentity permutations
three_law_identification.restricted_one_k_law_pass: Both H_block and G_block must separately satisfy e_s<=0.8, r_s<=0.8, a_s<=0.8, and unique identity assignment. H-only does not isolate the K-induced mechanism; G-only does not establish the actual predictor law.
three_law_identification.full_global_positive_control: Apply the same e_s, r_s, a_s and unique-assignment metrics to H_global=d[D(E(x)K)-x]/dx. Report G_global=d[D(E(x)K)-D(E(x))]/dx diagnostically.
three_law_identification.full_global_pass: For H_global, e_s^global<=0.8, r_s^global<=0.8, a_s^global<=0.8, and Hungarian(C_s^global) uniquely equals [0,1,2]; all four are required.

closure_and_coordinate_null.null_construction: Use fixed sign-pair-preserving coordinate permutations; permute encoded coordinates and P together while K and D remain fixed, then recompute autograd physical-space Jacobians.
closure_and_coordinate_null.null_assignment_metric: For each null replicate separately compute a_s,H^null and a_s,G^null; n_s,H=a_s,H/median(a_s,H^null) and n_s,G=a_s,G/median(a_s,G^null).
closure_and_coordinate_null.zero_null_reference_rule: All null/sign wins use strict raw observed<median-null comparisons. If a null median is <=1e-12, an exact zero tie is assigned ratio 1.0 and cannot pass the <=0.8 ratio gate; a positive observation uses observation/1e-12.
closure_and_coordinate_null.wrong_source_mask_is_not_evaluated: A wrong source projector can win trivially by erasing activity. Law derangements change only the candidate true-law assignment, never the predicted source chart.

direct_active_code_cloud_closure.scope: Approximate one-step closure of encoded activity observed on the fixed local verification clouds; this is not a claim that every vector in the coordinate subspace is invariant.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.evaluation_points: Within each basin's 256 frozen radius-0.18 verification points, freeze the indices whose current support is assigned to that basin's already calibration-matched family, then score that fixed subset with P_b. Do not condition on next-state support or leakage outcome.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.row_count_provenance: Record every seed-basin assigned verification-point count. The existing >=0.60 verification match-rate gate implies at least ceil(0.60*256)=154 points; fewer points make the routing row and closure row invalid.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.row_vector_primary_ratio: L_s,b=RMS_points||z P_b K(I-P_b)||_2 / RMS_points||z P_b(K-I)||_2, where z=E(x).
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.rms_definition: RMS over points of the latent-coordinate Euclidean norm: sqrt(mean over fixed verification points of sum over latent coordinates of squared entries); numerator and denominator use the identical points.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.denominator_validity: Every seed-basin RMS denominator must be finite and strictly greater than 1e-8; every numerator and ratio must be finite. A violation makes that seed not direct-closure-evaluable and counts against joint/G-only closure minima, but it does not invalidate the separately evaluable H-only or H_global predictor tiers.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.descriptive_raw_activity_ratio: RMS||z P_b K(I-P_b)||_2 / RMS||z P_b K||_2.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.coordinate_null: Use the same 32 frozen sign-pair-preserving coordinate permutations as the H/G null. After freezing the matched-family point indices, form z'=z[:,pi] and P_b'=pi(P_b) with positive/negative partners moved together, keep K and the point indices fixed, do not reroute, and compute max_b L_s,b^null. This matches the broad packet's z+P-together/K-fixed semantics.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.per_seed_gate: max_b L_s,b<=0.50 and max_b L_s,b / median_null(max_b L_s,b^null)<=0.80; both are required.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.aggregate_gate: At least 8 of 10 sparse seeds pass the complete per-seed closure gate, at least 24 of 30 seed-basin rows have L_s,b<=0.50, and at least 9 of 10 seeds have observed max_b L below the median-null max_b L.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.mechanism_dependency: The aggregate closure gate is required for joint H/G and G-only one-K mechanism tiers, but not for the H-only predictor tier.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.dense_secondary: Compute and report identical ratios using the paired dense center top-k projectors on exactly the paired sparse-family-assigned physical points. Dense closure is secondary: a nonfinite or tiny dense change denominator is reported but does not make an otherwise finite dense H_block row ineligible and does not determine the frozen H_block recipe-specificity decision.
direct_active_code_cloud_closure.threshold_selection_disclosure: The absolute 0.50 and observed/null 0.80 thresholds reuse the broad packet's already-open strong closure gates and were chosen with old GatedLocalLinear seeds 0-2 visible: all-current change leakage was 0.284, 0.315, and 0.254, with median permutation null 0.807, 0.777, and 0.824. The 8/10, 24/30, and 9/10 replication counts were fixed before any new seed 100-109 run. This direct-closure test is prospective for seeds 100-109, not outcome-blind with respect to seeds 0-2.

broad_complementary_evidence.role: Separate 15-system/45-run evidence for approximate projected one-step closure of observed code clouds; it does not substitute for new-seed V2 and does not establish whole-subspace invariance or distinct laws.

autograd_differentiability_kink_guard.method: For each basin and epsilon, evaluate both h_f^block and g_f^block at c_b +/- epsilon e_i for both physical coordinate directions and form central-difference 2x2 Jacobians H_fd and G_fd. No epsilon is selected.
autograd_differentiability_kink_guard.per_seed_differentiability_validity: All three basins must pass d^H<=0.1 and d^G<=0.1 at both frozen epsilons for that seed to be primary-evaluable.
autograd_differentiability_kink_guard.failure_interpretation: The LISTA/sign-split center is too close to a kink for a defensible point-Jacobian claim; do not substitute a favorable finite epsilon.

center_forecast_guards_and_affine_law_ga.normalization: Every quantity is divided by the RMS true update ||Delta_b delta|| on the fixed radius-0.18 verification disk for basin b.
center_forecast_guards_and_affine_law_ga.affine_local_law_gate: At least 24 of all 30 scientific seed-basin rows must have both normalized restricted-forecast error<=0.25 and normalized K-induced update<=0.25.
center_forecast_guards_and_affine_law_ga.claim_guard: Failure leaves only the applicable H/G point-Jacobian tier. The phrases affine local law, fixed-point law, or local law are forbidden unless both H_block and G_block aggregate gates and this affine gate pass.

finite_radius_robustness_not_selection.method: At each radius use fixed antithetic directions around c_b. Separately subtract h_f^block(c_b) and g_f^block(c_b), then fit centered physical-space finite-radius slopes H_finite and G_finite without choosing a radius.
finite_radius_robustness_not_selection.normalized_linear_fit_residual: For centered changes y_i=M_model(c_b+r u_i)-M_model(c_b), fit y_i approximately M_finite r u_i through the origin and report eta=sqrt(mean_i ||y_i-M_finite r u_i||_2^2)/max(sqrt(mean_i ||y_i||_2^2),1e-12), separately for H and G at every radius.
finite_radius_robustness_not_selection.residual_threshold_provenance: The eta<=0.25 cutoff exactly reuses V1's already-frozen validity threshold max_local_fit_relative_residual=0.25 from global_k_distinct_laws_card.json. V1 outcomes were visible, but this unchanged cutoff and the new residual computation are fixed before any seed-100--109 training or evaluation.
finite_radius_robustness_not_selection.finite_neighborhood_extension_gate: The joint H_block/G_block aggregate gate must pass. The same at least 24 of 30 seed-basin rows must each be kink-valid, pass both affine center guards, and, for each of H and G, have rho<=0.25 at radii 0.01 and 0.03, identify their own law at all five radii, and have eta<=0.25 at all five radii. Missing or nonfinite residuals fail the row.
finite_radius_robustness_not_selection.failure_interpretation: Retain only the applicable kink-guarded point-Jacobian tier; do not claim a finite-neighborhood local law.

per_seed_sparse_gate.joint_seed_pass: Require every H-only and G-only seed condition, including direct family-projected-code closure; no H, G, global-positive-control, kink, decoded-closure, projected-code closure, or coordinate-null gate may be omitted.
per_seed_sparse_gate.g_only_seed_pass: Require kink validity, H_global positive control, all G_block e/r/a/unique thresholds, block/source closure, the complete direct family-projected-code closure gate, and G coordinate-null threshold; omit H_block law and H-null thresholds.
per_seed_sparse_gate.h_only_seed_pass: Require kink validity, H_global positive control, all H_block e/r/a/unique thresholds, and H coordinate-null threshold; omit G_block law, closure, and G-null thresholds. This is reporting-only and cannot support the one-K mechanism claim.

aggregate_sparse_gate.kink_concordance_for_aggregation: A seed-basin H/G law, direct-closure, affine, or finite-radius row counts toward a mechanism gate only if that same seed-basin passes both estimands at both finite-difference epsilons. A seed-level H/G or direct-closure coordinate-null win counts only for a complete three-basin kink-valid seed. Missing or invalid rows are failures, so law/closure/extension and kink counts cannot be satisfied by disjoint rows. Report each numerator and its kink-valid denominator.
aggregate_sparse_gate.g_only_gate: Require at least 8 G-only seed passes, the frozen G row counts, at least 9 G coordinate-null wins, the complete direct family-projected-code aggregate gate, and the joint H/G kink-validity minima. A pass permits only a distinct K-induced-update-Jacobian claim.
aggregate_sparse_gate.h_only_reporting: If H_block passes its row/assignment gates but G_block fails, report support-restricted predictor-Jacobian recovery with K-induced mechanism unresolved; do not claim one K encodes the local laws.

preconditions: the sparse H-only support-restricted predictor recovery gate passes
all ten dense checkpoints pass the exact tanh zero-sparsity zero-WD audit
at least nine paired seeds have an evaluable sparse family map, finite dense center top-k projectors with exact per-basin cardinality equality, and complete sparse and dense H/G kink checks
dense H_global predictive positive control passes e,r,a<=0.8 plus unique identity assignment on at least eight of ten seeds
dense_recipe_specificity_gate.zero_dense_reference_ratio_rule: For every primary or secondary sparse/dense ratio, if both numerator and denominator are <=1e-12, record 1.0 (tie); if only the dense denominator is <=1e-12, divide the positive sparse numerator by 1e-12 (failure, not a win). Raw sparse<dense comparisons determine sign wins.
dense_recipe_specificity_gate.g_secondary_report: Also report paired G_block row and assignment ratios with the same 0.9 reference lines and exact sign count, but they do not substitute for or determine the H_block specificity decision.
dense_recipe_specificity_gate.aggregation: paired scientific seed; no basin or point pseudoreplication
dense_recipe_specificity_gate.missing_or_kink_invalid_pair_rule: A missing, law-invalid, or incomplete-kink paired seed is a failure for the frozen 9-of-10 sign claim and cannot enter the ratio distributions; exact sign p-values always use ten trials.
dense_recipe_specificity_gate.complete_recipe_caveat: The primary dense arm remains the provenance-locked symmetric tanh [64,64] recipe; no outcome-selected capacity variant is substituted. Sparse LISTA/sign-split/normalized-dictionary-decoder/L1/weight-decay-1e-4 and dense tanh/linear-output/nn.Linear-decoder/no-L1/weight-decay-0 differ in architecture, decoder normalization, regularization, and trainable parameter count: 95,104 versus 87,040 total (8,064 or 9.26% more for sparse), with 29,056 versus 20,992 encoder parameters (38.4% more for sparse). Latent dimension, 65,536-parameter dense K, 512 trainable decoder slope parameters, data, budget, and every-step-reencoding selector are exact matches, but decoder implementations are not architecture-matched. A pass supports only specificity of the complete sparse recipe relative to steelmanned dense center top-k masks; it cannot identify sparsity or capacity alone as the cause.
dense_recipe_specificity_gate.dense_ineligibility: The sparse H/G result may still pass, but no relative recipe-specificity claim is permitted.

gpu_utilization_and_schedule.reason_evaluation_cpu_only: Twenty 2D autograd checkpoint evaluations are too small to justify a GPU allocation.

smoke.active_sample_window: from the latest of 20 training-start markers through the latest of 20 training-end markers, inclusive, so the low-concurrency tail is not discarded
smoke.whole_window_policy_after_utilization_on: No warm-up exclusion or padding: the utilization decision still includes all startup and tail samples in the complete active window; only genuine smoke optimization steps increase from 2,000 to 5,000.
smoke.environment_preflight: After sourcing cluster_env, a source-locked Python preflight with no jq dependency must authenticate the card/source lock and exact smoke task table/manifest before any status directory, task process, lifecycle marker, telemetry sampler, or output is created.
smoke.failure_branch: Do not launch scientific training. Any packing amendment must be frozen using utilization-only evidence; no smoke scientific metric may be opened.

scientific_training_after_smoke_pass.one_mixed_pack: 10 sparse plus paired 10 dense scientific tasks, so dense is not conditionally launched after seeing sparse outcomes
scientific_training_after_smoke_pass.utilization_alert: after all processes start, flag a rolling ten-minute mean below 85%; do not change training hyperparameters
scientific_training_after_smoke_pass.postpack_telemetry_assessment: Before checkpoint audit, an outcome-blind CPU job must authenticate lifecycle/GPU telemetry, include the tail through the final training-end marker, record the minimum rolling ten-minute utilization, and flag but not tune/relaunch if it is below 85%.

gpu_utilization_and_schedule.post_training_dependency_chain: mixed training -> outcome-blind scientific GPU telemetry assessment -> exact config/checkpoint audit -> CPU evaluation array for all 20 arm-seed rows -> summary only after every required shard completes -> authenticated V2 compact packet
gpu_utilization_and_schedule.dense_schedule: Dense new seeds train concurrently in the same mixed GPU pack and are evaluated only under the same frozen v2 protocol; the current independent dense-v1 campaign neither selects nor substitutes v2 checkpoints.

mechanism_claim_tiers.finite_neighborhood_local_laws: Joint sparse H_block/G_block point-Jacobian, direct family-projected-code closure, affine, and joint H/G finite-neighborhood gates pass. Claim three support-selected finite-neighborhood local laws encoded through one unchanged K on this controlled benchmark, while saying only that family-projected codes zP_b from the matched verification clouds are approximately closed; never claim that unprojected z already lies in P_b or that the whole support-coordinate subspace is algebraically invariant.
mechanism_claim_tiers.affine_fixed_point_local_laws: Joint sparse H_block/G_block point-Jacobian, direct family-projected-code closure, and affine gates pass but the joint finite-neighborhood gate fails. Claim support-selected affine/fixed-point local laws, not finite-neighborhood laws, source containment, or whole-subspace invariance.

Claim distinct actual-predictor and K-induced Jacobians plus closure of family-projected codes from matched verification clouds only; the phrase local law is forbidden.
mechanism_claim_tiers.distinct_k_induced_update_jacobians_only: The frozen G-only gate, including direct family-projected-code closure, passes but H_block does not. Claim only distinct support-selected K-induced-update Jacobians and closure of family-projected codes from matched verification clouds; do not say the actual predictor recovers local laws, that unprojected codes lie in the support, or that whole coordinate subspaces are invariant.

mechanism_claim_tiers.global_predictor_only: The H_global predictive positive control passes on at least eight seeds but the support-block joint gate fails. Attribute recovery to the full encoder/decoder/global-K predictor, not support-selected K blocks.

The relative claim is only that the complete LISTA/sign-split/sparse recipe has more specific actual restricted-predictor support-basis law identification than steelmanned dense masks; G_block specificity is reported separately.
relative_specificity_tiers.not_sparse_recipe_specific: The dense comparison is valid and the specificity gate fails. Make no relative sparse-recipe specificity claim.

decision_structure.mandatory_positive_claim_caveat: Encoder/decoder architecture and normalization, sign split, L1 sparsity loss, sparse weight decay 1e-4 versus dense weight decay 0, and audited capacity (sparse +9.26% total/+38.4% encoder) remain confounded. The inherited validation selector re-encodes physical state every step and is not autonomous repeated-K selection. The closure test starts from zP_b and therefore does not establish that unprojected z is contained in P_b. No positive branch may say that sparsity or capacity alone caused the result or that an entire support-coordinate subspace is invariant.
decision_structure.reporting_rule: Report one mechanism tier and one relative-specificity tier; never collapse them into a sparsity-only causal statement.
